metadata.summary: Arsenal are in advanced talks with Aston Villa to sign Ezri Konsa.
metadata.content: Ezri Konsa transfer news: Arsenal in advanced talks to sign Aston Villa and England defender | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Ezri Konsa transfer news: Arsenal in advanced talks to sign Aston Villa and England defender Ezri Konsa has two years remaining on his Aston Villa contract; Arsenal also held an interest in Jarell Quansah but look set to move for Konsa; Arsenal currently have William Saliba and Jurrien Timber out injured By Adrian Kajumba and Lyall Thomas Wednesday 19 August 2026 12:42, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Watch Ezri Konsa's best moments for Aston Villa last season Arsenal are in advanced talks with Aston Villa to sign Ezri Konsa. Sky Sports News understands Konsa has agreed personal terms with the Premier League champions and it is a transfer that could move quickly. Arsenal are currently looking for a new defender with William Saliba out for an extended period of time, with Jurrien Timber also sidelined with a long-term groin problem. The Gunners' interest in Konsa has lasted all summer with Villa initially valuing him at £60m - a valuation Arsenal were unwilling to meet. metadata.content: Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United close to full agreement with Brighton for Cameroon midfielder | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United close to full agreement with Brighton for Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba is understood to be preparing to travel to Manchester ahead of a medical; The deal is expected to be worth in excess of £60m and a five-year contract is ready for the Cameroon international to sign once the deal is formally concluded Wednesday 19 August 2026 11:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player With Manchester United edging closer to reaching a full agreement with Brighton for Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba, take a look at his Premier League best bits Manchester United are close to a full agreement with Brighton to sign Carlos Baleba. The club already have a five-year contract ready for him to sign when the deal is formally concluded. The final fee and structure are not yet fully agreed, but the deal is expected to be worth in excess of £60m. The 22-year-old is understood to be preparing to travel to Manchester, where medical plans will also be scheduled swiftly once the deal is completed. messages.text: Brook returns to top of Test batting rankings

metadata.summary: England batter Harry Brook has returned to the top of the ICC men's Test batting rankings, with Australia's Travis Head dropping down after a couple of low scores in their shock Test defeat to Bangladesh.
metadata.content: England's Harry Brook goes top of ICC Test batting rankings as Travis Head falls after Australia's shock Bangladesh defeat | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content England's Harry Brook goes top of ICC Test batting rankings as Travis Head falls after Australia's shock Bangladesh defeat Harry Brook moves top of ICC men's Test batting rankings for fourth time; Australia's Travis Head drops down to fourth, with Joe Root second and Steve Smith third; watch the first Test between England and Pakistan at Headingley, live on Sky Sports from Wednesday Wednesday 19 August 2026 10:59, UK Image: England's Harry Brook has returned to the top of the ICC men's Test batting rankings England batter Harry Brook has returned to the top of the ICC men's Test batting rankings, with Australia's Travis Head dropping down after a couple of low scores in their shock Test defeat to Bangladesh. It is Brook's fourth stint at No 1, coming as England's new era under returning captain Joe Root gets under way with the first Test of the three-match series against Pakistan at Headingley - live on Sky Sports . Brook first claimed top spot in December 2024. Joe Root returns as captain as England take on Pakistan at Headingley LIVE! England begin new Test cricket era without Ben Stokes Not got Sky? messages.text: Rangers sign Nedeljkovic from Aston Villa

metadata.summary: Rangers have signed right-back Kosta Nedeljkovic from Aston Villa.
metadata.content: Kosta Nedeljkovic: Rangers sign Aston Villa right-back on loan with £4m obligation to buy Serbia international | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Kosta Nedeljkovic: Rangers sign Aston Villa right-back on loan with £4m obligation to buy Serbia international Rangers have signed 11 players this summer; Kosta Nedeljkovic joins amid interest from other clubs following talks with boss Derek McInnes and Serbian team-mate Vanja Dragojevic, who just moved to Ibrox; Rangers are working on adding a winger and striker before the transfer window shuts Wednesday 19 August 2026 10:06, UK Image: Kosta Nedeljkovic has joined Rangers Rangers have signed right-back Kosta Nedeljkovic from Aston Villa. The 20-year-old has moved to Ibrox on a season-long loan, with a £4m obligation to buy included in the deal, which will be triggered based on the number of games he plays. Sky Sports News understands Rangers saw off competition from other clubs to sign Nedeljkovic after he held talks with manager Derek McInnes and his Serbia team-mate Vanja Dragojevic, who moved to the club earlier this summer.
